schema:
use identity guests

table items:
  owner: principal
  n: int
  value: int
  by byOwnerN: owner, n, id
  cap 100 by owner
  immutable owner, n
  read <- .owner = viewer
  insert <- deny
  update <- .owner = viewer
  delete <- deny

query point(itemId: items):
  return items[itemId]

query page(c: cursor ?):
  return items[viewer] after c first 50 by byOwnerN

mutation bump(itemId: items):
  item = items[itemId] ! else NOT_FOUND
  update items[item] { value: item.value + 1 }
  return item.value + 1

query small():
  return 1

query echo(data: json <=524288):
  return data

query branch(fast: bool):
  if fast:
    return 1
